about: cap.so a fourth time: the hero, the laptop mock-up, the feature sections, then Pricing in the sticky nav bar (after brushing past the Help menu) and Lifetime. Recorded 2026-09-24 as 'Cap-demo (2)'; production missed Lifetime (it had not been redeployed with the stayed-changed search) and the replay then showed Pricing missed as well.
notes: Pricing: hovered from 13.9s with no pointer drawn (the tab capture again); the hand appears on it at 14.6s and the new page arrives at 15.08s, so the click is ~14.95s. The tracker logged the page change as a one-frame dy of -0.21 and inferEvents discarded it as a scroll before any navigation was minted; a lone shift is now a scroll only when the video's own measurement saw the page move.
Lifetime: the switch flips ~19.4s; stayedChanged measures 44% changed.
stranger_budget_s / stranger_budget_pixel_s are RATCHETS measured on 2026-09-24. Lower them when they improve; never raise them.
